blocks.html: Robinsons Malls The Gift of Change Reaches out to Typhoon Lando Victims

Robinsons Malls The Gift of Change program remains true to its commitment to serve the public as it conducted its relief operations in Pangasinan, Pampanga and Bulacan for the benefit of the families affected by Typhoon Lando. For Robinsons Place Pangasinan, Robinsons Malls The Gift of Change program was able to give bags of relief goods and clothing to afflicted families in the affected barangays namely Barangay Ambonao ( Sitio Balani ) and Cabilocaan (Sitio Tokok).
The Gift of Change is an ongoing coinbank donation campaign in all Robinsons Malls nationwide. It is currently supporting 19 communities, with CSR projects to include The Gift of Sight, Pailaw sa Barangay, Binyagang Bayan, Libreng Bakuna, Kasalang Bayan and Libreng Pintura para Sa Eskuwela.
